summary: 2026-27 home kit. The KHL's own marketing blog (sports.ru, 13 September 2026) says Avtomobilist kept its playing kits unchanged from 2025-26. Individual shirt placements could not be verified from any source that opens here: the club site blocks this server and the last archived capture of its sponsors page is 8 July 2025. That page lists five club sponsors - UMMC (also named general sponsor in the site footer), Winline, Uralmashzavod, Russian Copper Company (RMK) and ALMA ceramica - all recorded as club partners, not shirt placements.
